GUI.note:
Assessment
1. Clinical History & Comorbidities:
Jessie Donnelly (58F, DOB 1966-05-23, MRN SYN-0069845) has severe symptomatic bilateral primary knee osteoarthritis (Kellgren-Lawrence grade 3 in medial compartments), persistent pain (7/10) and functional limitation despite acetaminophen 1000 mg PO TID (3000 mg/day), 12 weeks of physiotherapy, and 6 kg weight loss (current weight 79 kg, BMI ~29.7 kg/m2). Orthopedics evaluated on 2024-05-10: patient is not ready for knee arthroplasty (reassess in 6 months) and recommended optimizing non-surgical management.
Comorbidities & Active Medications:
- Aspirin-Exacerbated Respiratory Disease (AERD / NSAID-exacerbated respiratory disease): Adult-onset asthma, chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps (s/p two polypectomies), history of wheezing and nasal congestion within 60 minutes of oral ibuprofen (2015, 2019) and naproxen (2021), confirmed by positive graded oral aspirin challenge on 2022-03-02 (FEV1 fall 24% and acute nasal congestion at 45 mg aspirin). Maintained on budesonide/formoterol 160/4.5 mcg 2 puffs BID, fluticasone propionate 50 mcg nasal spray, and montelukast 10 mg daily.
